description: This file contains test functions for the mp7 module within the iscc_sdk package, including tests for byte-to-bit conversion, bit popping, and signature reading with assertions on expected outputs.

classes.name: mp7.Frame
classes.description: A class representing a frame in the mp7 signature, used in signature parsing tests.

methods.name: test_calc_byte_to_bit3
methods.description: Tests the conversion of bytes to a list of bits using mp7.calc_byte_to_bit3.

methods.name: test_pop_bits
methods.description: Tests the bit popping function on a bitarray, verifying the extracted value and remaining bits.

methods.name: test_read_mp7_signature
methods.description: Tests the extraction and parsing of an mp7 signature from a video file, asserting properties of the resulting Frame object.
